name: openreplay
description: Query and explore your OpenReplay session replays and product analytics.

interface.longDescription:
Query your OpenReplay data in natural language. Search and replay user sessions in an embedded player, and build interactive charts to track trends, explore web analytics, map user journeys, catch drop-offs with funnels, and monitor Core Web Vitals. Review the problems Smart Issues found in your recordings and kick off Smart Tests runs.

Works with OpenReplay Cloud and self-hosted instances. On first use, sign in to your OpenReplay account in the browser; ask to switch instances to use a self-hosted one. Mobile recordings open in the OpenReplay UI rather than the embedded player.
capabilities: Search recorded user sessions by user, device, location and behavior
Replay web sessions in an embedded player
Chart session trends, top pages, browsers and countries
Map user journeys and measure funnel conversion
Review Smart Issues and trigger Smart Tests runs
defaultPrompt: Chart daily sessions for the last 7 days
Which pages had the most visits this week?

positive.prompt: Show me the most recent sessions in OpenReplay
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the session list with user, device, location and duration for recent sessions, and summarizes them.

positive.prompt: Chart the number of sessions per day over the last 7 days
positive.expected_behavior: Renders a line chart of daily session counts for the last 7 days.

positive.prompt: Which pages were visited most in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Renders a ranked bar list of the most visited pages with their counts.

positive.prompt: How are our Core Web Vitals looking this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Renders Core Web Vitals cards (such as LCP, CLS and TTFB) with percentile values and points out any metric rated poor.
Finds the latest session and opens it in the embedded replay player.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
Write a Python function that reverses a string.
Show my Google Analytics bounce rate for last week.
